study: PenDigits new-fitting-seed confirmation of KAHM input scaling
design_status: Frozen after the initial paired comparison and before any results from these new fitting seeds. This is a follow-up, not independent external preregistration.
primary_outcome: Writer-balanced held-out MSE, pooled equally across both coordinates and all three horizons, reported for each new fitting seed and as their mean.
secondary_outcomes: Per-horizon coordinate-pooled RMSE and fitting-seed SD

modes.minmax: Primary: training featurewise min/max to [-1,1], with affine extrapolation for future extremes.
modes.minmax_clip: Same training min/max, clip transformed future inputs to [-1,1].
modes.raw: Existing bounded raw histories, without standardization.

selection: Original runner selects one candidate per family and coordinate using mean validation-writer MSE over horizons, then fewer features, then candidate name. All six coordinate/seed families freeze before scoring test writers. No scaling arm is selected by confirmation test scores.
freshness: Seeds4701,4702,4703 change per-writer training-stroke subsampling and geometry fitting. Training/validation/test writer partitions and the eligible held-out cohort remain identical to the original experiment. This is NOT a fresh test-cohort replication.
sampling: Same original24 training writers,6 validation writers and13 eligible held-out writers; strokes are subsampled from the same training data pool and may overlap earlier draws. Training seeds are not independent writer samples.
scope: Only campaign name and fitting seeds differ from original config; within each seed all four arms share records, labels, hyperparameters, horizons, targets, and the exact evaluation procedure.
statistical_scope: Descriptive evidence for robustness to fitting randomness on this fixed held-out cohort. Original within-arm Hoeffding statements require the unverified iid-writer assumption and do not jointly cover preprocessing arms. No new writer-population guarantee follows from reusing the cohort.
reporting: Report all four arms and all fitting seeds, including worse results. Assess primary-arm gain magnitude and consistency without changing the fixed protocol or selecting variants from confirmation outcomes.
